scientific_integrity: The general theorem follows from edge-flux reversal and a rooted group-ring recurrence; exhaustive and direct finite computations support but do not replace the proof. Published background ingredients and inaccessible historical material are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite simple labelled trees and strict synchronous integer diffusion; counts primitive period-two orbits at a fixed conserved chip total, or modulo common translation when unrestricted. No transient basin or convergence-time census. Unindexed historical equivalence remains possible.
title: A polynomial-time mass-resolved period-two census for integer diffusion on arbitrary trees
